## Kyrie - PDF Generation & Send  (v3: static map + Question-Script-aware GPT)
Webhook -> Prep Payload (1,478 static mappings + 18 Question Scripts embedded) -> GPT Translator (gpt-4o-mini, JSON mode, explicit derivation rules: Total Years Married, Age, Today, repeated sections, address/name splits) -> Fill PDF (https://codeeee.onrender.com) -> Email + Update Call Log.

**What changed from v2:**
- Prep Payload now passes the form-specific Question Script to GPT so it understands what each raw answer means.
- System prompt enumerates derivation rules instead of vaguely saying "infer".
- validFields is deduped + sorted for stable prompts.
- A `today` date is provided so GPT can compute Age and fill Todays Date fields without guessing.

**Plug in:**
- GPT Translator -> Authorization header -> replace `Bearer YOUR_OPENAI_API_KEY`.
- Update Call Log -> Authorization header -> replace `Bearer YOUR_AIRTABLE_PAT` (rotate the old PAT first; it appeared in chat history).
- Email PDF to Staff -> Gmail credential already wired.

const slug = (s) => String(s).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "_").replace(/^_|_$/g, "");

const b = $input.first().json.body || $input.first().json;
const rawFormName = b.formName || "";
const formName = FORM_ALIASES[rawFormName] || rawFormName;
const map = KEY_MAPS[formName] || {};
const questionScript = QUESTION_SCRIPTS[formName] || "";

let raw = {};
try { raw = typeof b.answersJson === "string" ? JSON.parse(b.answersJson) : (b.answersJson || {}); } catch (e) { raw = {}; }

// Apply static map: Kyrie key -> PDF field name. Try as-is, then snake_case.
const mapped = {};
const unmapped = {};
for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(raw)) {
  const direct = map[k] || map[slug(k)];
  if (direct) mapped[direct] = v;
  else unmapped[k] = v;
}

// Full list of valid PDF field names (deduped, sorted for stable prompts)
const validFields = [...new Set(Object.values(map))].sort();

return [{ json: {
  recordId:    b.recordId || "",
  formName,
  rawFormName,
  clientName:  b.clientName || "",
  clientPhone: b.clientPhone || "",
  mappedFields: mapped,
  unmappedFields: unmapped,
  validFields,
  questionScript,
  rawAnswers: raw,
  today: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)
}}];
